description: This file defines the NationalityDao class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for database operations related to the Nationality entity, including CRUD operations and querying functions.

classes.name: NationalityDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling database operations related to the Nationality entity, including save, retrieve, count, delete, and existence check functions.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Persists a Nationality entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Nationality entities based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for iterating over the list of nationalities according to filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of Nationality entities matching the search filter.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Fetches a Nationality entity by its unique ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingNationalityIds
methods.description: Retrieves existing nationality IDs from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Returns a Nationality entity matching the provided name, or null if none matches.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple nationalities identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks if a nationality with the specified name already exists.
